Thanks for taking a look — brief background: ProcureLabs is running a three-month collaboration with Redwood's Applied Research team under a government research grant. The PI needs access to a pilot cluster immediately for data ingest; our finance team is funded via grant milestones and can't issue POs on the short notice required.

We'd like to ask for a temporary invoice-only onboarding (no PO) for up to $8,000 over the next 90 days so we can start the work. We can provide:
- W9 and bank verification (attached)
- Signed statement of grant funding and billing contact
- Invoice template with GL coding

Appreciate it — Alicia

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear note and for attaching the docs. We're sympathetic to grant timelines and have an established process for limited invoice-only exceptions, but we need to collect a small set of artifacts and approvals first. High level: procurement needs vendor intake + evidence, Finance (Marissa) will sign off on the credit/limit, and Legal may request standard terms if this expands.

To move quickly, please complete the Redwood vendor intake form (I've attached the link below) and confirm these items:
1) W9 (you already attached)
2) Bank letter or voided check (attached)
3) Point of contact for billing and purchase-authority (name + email + phone)
4) Expected total spend and invoice cadence (monthly/one-off) — you said ~$8k over 90 days, is that correct?

If procurement signs off, we can provision a short-term "invoice-only" onboarding for up to $10,000 with the following guardrails:
- 90-day duration
- Pre-approved invoice GL mapping provided by ProcureLabs
- Invoices submitted to billing@redwoodinference.com with "ProcureLabs Pilot" in subject
- No auto-renew; any additional spend requires PO or explicit approval

I've looped in Priya from Procurement to confirm next steps and to run the formal intake. Once they have the filled form and the bank letter, they can escalate to Finance for the one-time limit.

Next: Priya — can you confirm the intake link, any evidence checklist, and expected SLAs for provisioning?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Hi all — quick procurement note and checklist. We can approve a temporary invoice-only admission for a new supplier under the following conditions:

Required items (please upload to the intake portal):
- Completed Vendor Intake Form (PDF)
- W9 (completed)
- Bank verification letter (recent)
- Primary billing contact + backup contact (name/email/phone)
- Invoice sample with GL codes (so we can map to our ERP)

Controls and limits:
- Approval limited to $10,000 aggregate over 90 days
- Procurement will apply a "pilot" vendor tag and require consolidated monthly invoices
- Finance (Marissa) must confirm there is an approved budget line; procurement will not issue exceptions without budget confirmation

Timeline: if Alicia uploads the intake form and the bank letter by end of day Friday (09/04), procurement can complete the verification and ask Finance for limit approval by Monday (09/07). If Finance approves, IT can provision access the same day.

Marissa — are you able to confirm the budget line and give a thumbs-up for the $10k limit?

Thanks,
